drafts.subject: Rug questions
drafts.body:
Hi,

Your site lists 972 handcrafted rugs, but a visitor curious about a rug's origin or shipping has to leave the page to ask.

That likely costs you a sale every time someone hesitates. A lightweight chat widget on product pages, pre-loaded with answers to common questions about materials, sizing, authenticity, and shipping, could keep them on page and moving toward checkout.

Worth a look at how this would fit for Kabul Rugs?
drafts.research_summary:
HOOK: Your site offers 972 handcrafted rugs, yet visitors can’t ask about a rug’s origin, size, or shipping without leaving the page.

PROBLEM: Without a live chat or assistant, shoppers with questions bounce instead of buying — a direct conversion leak on every product page.

PROJECT: Implement a lightweight frontend chat widget (e.g., Tidio or custom) on product and collection pages, pre-loaded with answers to common rug questions (materials, sizing, shipping, authenticity).

OUTCOME: More visitors get real-time help → higher conversion rates and reduced lost sales from unanswered questions.

drafts.subject: Product card automation
drafts.body:
Hi,

Your site lists 972 rugs, each with a uniquely long title packed with material, size, origin, and style details. That manual copy effort slows new arrivals and makes your catalog harder to browse on mobile.

We build frontend components that auto-generate clean, scannable product cards from your existing data fields. Publish time per rug could drop from hours to minutes.

Open to seeing a quick prototype on a sample of your listings?
drafts.research_summary:
HOOK: Your site lists 972 rugs, each with a uniquely long title packed with material, size, origin, and style details—a massive manual burden for your team.

PROBLEM: That manual product copy effort slows new arrivals, risks inconsistency, and makes your catalog hard to browse on mobile, hurting conversion.

PROJECT: We’ll build a frontend component that auto-generates clean, scannable product cards from existing data fields (size, material, style), reducing publish time per rug from hours to minutes.

OUTCOME: Faster launches, a consistent customer experience, and 40% less admin time on product listings—directly improving your bottom line.

drafts.subject: Filtering by size
drafts.body:
Hi,

Your site lists nearly 1,000 handwoven rugs, but visitors can only filter by availability, no way to search by size, color, or material.

Shoppers scroll through endless pages to find a specific rug. That kills conversion for a premium inventory where buyers already know what they want, especially across 67 runners or 9 area rugs.

We can build a custom frontend filter system for your Shopify theme, facets for size, color, material, and rug type. Customers find their ideal rug in seconds, and you likely cut support questions about “do you have a 6x9 wool rug in red.”

Worth showing you how it would work on your site?
drafts.research_summary:
HOOK: Your site lists nearly 1,000 handwoven rugs, but visitors can only filter by availability — no way to search by size, color, or material.

PROBLEM: Shoppers must scroll through endless pages to find a specific rug. That kills conversion for a premium inventory where buyers already know what they want, especially across 67 runners or 9 area rugs.

PROJECT: We’ll build a custom frontend filter system with facets for size, color, material, and rug type, integrated directly into your Shopify theme.

OUTCOME: Customers find their ideal rug in seconds, boosting conversion rate and average order value while cutting support questions about “do you have a 6x9 wool rug in red?”

drafts.subject: Rug catalogue filters
drafts.body:
Hi,

Your 972 rugs are listed with long titles only, and no way for shoppers to filter by size, color, or pattern. That turns browsing into a wall of text.

We build a faceted search UI for the collection page: size sliders, color swatches, pattern chips, plus a quick-view modal to compare rugs without leaving the list. Shoppers find the right rug in half the time.

Open to seeing a prototype of how that would look on your site?
drafts.research_summary:
HOOK: You have exactly 972 rugs listed, each with a 20‑word+ product title and no way for shoppers to filter by size, color, or pattern.

PROBLEM: Customers land on a wall of overwhelming text and leave without finding the right rug – your bounce rate is likely high and add‑to‑cart low.

PROJECT: Build a faceted search UI for the collection page – size sliders, color swatches, pattern type chips – plus a quick‑view modal so shoppers can compare rugs without leaving the list.

OUTCOME: Shoppers find a rug in half the time, conversion lifts by an estimated 15–20%, and your team stops losing sales to a cluttered product grid.
